title: MDOT lists Black Zion Road median and two more Pontotoc County projects
excerpt: MDOT’s proposed schedule lists a median at U.S. 278, an I-22 traffic systems project in January and resurfacing on two state routes in February.

paragraphs.text: A directional median at U.S. 278 and Mississippi 342, also known as Black Zion Road, is on the Mississippi Department of Transportation’s November project list for Pontotoc County. The agency identifies it as work for state crews. Its Nov. 17 schedule also lists work on Interstate 22 and two state routes early next year.

The I-22 project is listed for January 2027. Its Pontotoc County segment runs from the Lee County line to the Union County line. MDOT calls the work an intelligent transportation systems project. A separate Lee County entry continues from the Pontotoc County line to Tupelo’s western city limits.

For February, MDOT lists milling and resurfacing on two stretches of highway. One is Mississippi 9 from Mississippi 341 to Mississippi 15. The other is Mississippi 770 from Mississippi 338 to Mississippi 15.
The months on the list are proposed. MDOT says projects can move earlier or later as it revises the schedule. The listings give no day for work to begin or for a lane to close.
